cameraPolicy: Fixed camera + rotated object and orbit camera + fixed object, same relative view and pose
hardRule: Accept real 90-degree profile and consistent depth/coverage through held-out angles before 360-degree head expansion; accept head360 before full-body

tasks.name: reference_baseline
tasks.action: Register reference character, camera calibration, source hashes and reproducible diagnostic frames

tasks.name: qa_shader_parity
tasks.action: Verify shared Beauty/ID/Depth/Alpha fragment coverage with depth-order and mask fault injection
tasks.engineeringEvidence: 7/7 real WebGL view samples four-pass alpha-coverage parity; deliberate mask and depth faults detected; RGBA semi-transparent clips remain untested

tasks.name: reference_head_semantics
tasks.action: Create independently authored 0/45/90 reference head layers and held-out 30/60/75 angles with annotated profile and hairline landmarks
tasks.pending: Independently review held-out images and semantic source identity

tasks.name: layered_head
tasks.action: Render a single head at 0/15/30/45/60/75/90 with 3D anchors, view-dependent depth, semantic ArtMesh warp and shared coverage
tasks.pending: 30/60/75 image review and optional view-conditioned corrective ArtMesh
tasks.engineeringEvidence: 0/45/90 SVG source key IoU 0.9954/0.9958/0.9940; renderer samples genuine keyed SVG art and SVG path strokes

tasks.name: plan_b_decision
tasks.action: Review true profile, held-out intermediate views, depth/ID agreement and authoring cost; decide expansion of the selected representation

tasks.name: original_art_uv_vdd
tasks.action: Extend head views to 180 and 270 with independently authored rear/left profile and key-specific VDD

tasks.name: head_motion
tasks.action: Combine independent head yaw, calibrated pitch, blink, and local hair movement

tasks.name: full_body
tasks.action: Integrate character body, bone/IK motion, foreshortening, foot contacts and full 192-frame acceptance

gates.name: INDEPENDENT_REFERENCE
gates.criterion: pass only when reference comes from independently authored art and provenance/sha

gates.name: REAL_SIDE_PROFILE
gates.criterion: 90 and 270 visible nasal tip, brow, chin, ear; pass machine+vision

gates.name: CORRECT_DEPTH_OCCLUSION
gates.criterion: front/side/back scalp/face/ear depth graph, sampled all 13 angles and negative controls

gates.name: PIXEL_COVERAGE_PARITY
gates.criterion: beauty/ID/depth/alpha same discard/clip; <=0.5 percent interior coverage mismatch, <=1px edge

gates.name: CAMERA_RELATIVE_ORBIT
gates.criterion: camera orbit vs model rotation equal at matching relative view with controlled lights

gates.name: SEAM_AND_CONTINUITY
gates.criterion: same-pose 0/360 same mask, 90/270 strips no floating islands

gates.name: ART_ANCHOR_FIDELITY
gates.criterion: authored cardinal reference silhouette IoU >=0.93 and landmarks <=2pct head height, plus visual

gates.name: INDEPENDENT_FULL_FRAME_VISUAL
gates.criterion: full-resolution angle board and contiguous side frame strips reviewed

gates.name: SCOPE_INTEGRITY
gates.criterion: head pass never implies fullbody/production pass

expectedExit: PASS_HEAD360_VISUAL or FAIL_VISUAL with exact evidence
